summary: Independent review of Jin Shu 86 owned units s0002–s0210 (s0140 absent) against the sealed Chinese, not the English glosses. Conventional Hui/Huai/Min/Yuan reign-year labels hold where the Chinese writes 永甯初, 永興中, 永嘉初, 湣帝即位, 建興初, 四載於茲, or 改年太興: Yongning 1 = AD 301, Yongxing = 304–306, Yongjia 1 = 307, Jianxing 1 = 313, Jianxing 4 = 316, Taixing 1 / Jianxing 6 = 318. Those are reign-year labels, not month/day Gregorian dates; Taishi 1 十二月丙寅 is already AD 266, which claim-566 correctly leaves unresolved. Undated-after-永嘉初 acts keep one-sided onOrAfter 307; post-湣帝即位 acts keep onOrAfter 313 without a false close. Gui's death stays an unresolved 313/314 competition from 在州十三年 versus conventional Jianxing 2; sui 60 is not turned into a birth year; 沒於賊 is not treated as death; 漢末 stays unresolved. Two chronology defects remain: the s0016 star-reading is closed to 301–301 without a year, and Qu Yun / Hu Song are closed to 316–316 despite 自去年九月. Eight explicit 死/斬/殺 deaths have attestation rows but no death predicate. Later reception (諡曰武公, speech-precedents, 討曹祛, 劉載) is kept off life dates. No research hold: the Chinese is enough to reject the closed years and to add the omitted deaths.
